test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 3 men and 7 women can complete a task in 10 days. On the other hand, 4 men and 6 women, take 8 days to complete the same task. How long will it take 10 women to complete the same task?
solution:
Given:

3men + 7women takes 10 days, 

4men + 6women takes 8 days.

Formula used:

Total work = Efficiency × days

Calculations:

By solving equation (1) and (2)

⇒ (3m + 7w) × 10 = (4m + 6w) × 8

⇒ 30m + 70w = 32m + 48w

⇒ 30m - 32m = 48w - 70w

⇒ -2m = -22w

⇒ m/w = 11/1

⇒ Total work = (4 × 11 + 6) × 8

⇒ Total work = 400 unit

⇒ Time taken by 10 woman = 400/10

⇒ Time taken by 10 woman = 40 days

∴ 10 woman can complete the work in 40 days
